items.name: Sarkari formal (official and legal-letter register, English and Hindi)
items.one_line: The register of Indian government orders, official letters, notices and legal correspondence: impersonal or third-person, precise, reference-numbered, courteous and fixed in form, in English, Hindi or both.

sources.title: DARPG, Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedure, 13th edition (2010)
sources.supports: drafts must be 'clear, concise and incapable of misconstruction' and avoid 'Lengthy sentences, abruptness, redundancy, circumlocution, superlatives and repetition'; 'I am directed to say' at the start 'has the effect of distancing the communicator from the reader' and a more direct format is preferred; letter = 'Sir/Madam' ... 'Yours faithfully'; office memorandum = third person, no salutation or subscription; demi-official letter = first person, 'personal and friendly tone'

sources.title: The Official Languages Act, 1963 (as amended 1967)
sources.supports: resolutions, general orders, rules, notifications, reports and press communiques of the Central Government are issued in both Hindi and English

sources.title: Microsoft Hindi Localization Style Guide
sources.supports: Hindi verbs carry a 'degree of respect (intimate, familiar, respect)'; requests and commands to the reader use the respectful form (करें, सहेजें)

sources.title: Hindi Sarang: कार्यालय ज्ञापन (office memorandum)
sources.supports: 'कार्यालय ज्ञापन अन्य पुरुष में लिखा जाता है'; 'इसकी भाषा आदेशात्मक नहीं होती बल्कि अनुरोधपरक होती है'; no संबोधन or अधोलेख (भवदीय आदि) (secondary, low confidence)

items.note: Markers: subject line and reference number/date first; passive or third person for decisions ('it has been decided', 'निर्णय लिया गया है'); defined terms used identically every time; numbers and dates exact; courteous fixed openings/closings by form (Sir/Madam ... Yours faithfully; महोदय/महोदया ... भवदीय/भवदीया for letters; none for an office memorandum); no superlatives, slang, emoji or exclamation marks. CSMOP itself warns against needless distance, so 'sarkari' is not an excuse for circumlocution: plain, direct sentences inside the fixed form. Hindi side uses tatsam administrative vocabulary (सूचित किया जाता है, अनुरोध है, संदर्भ) and the aap form throughout. Fits genre:government_press_note, genre:scheme_explainer, legal notices and official replies; the Hindi side of the CSMOP (Hindi edition) was not read. Contrast tone:academic_formal (argued, cited) and lang:hindustani_everyday (spoken).
